content.text:
I fixed the one problem I found on the products page. The "Add to cart" buttons had white text on a white background, so they looked empty. I haven't checked the page in a browser.

The cause was in `site/css/components.css`. `.btn-secondary` set its text color to `var(--color-surface)`, which is also its background color. I changed the text color to `var(--color-ink)`. The same class is used on other pages, so those buttons are fixed too.

The 16 functional tests pass. The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't diff against the earlier version. Instead I read the products markup and the product-related CSS (cards, chips, badges, thumbnails, bundles). I found nothing else wrong in them. If something still looks off, tell me what you're seeing and I'll look again.

STATUS: DONE
